title: 2015 AMC 10A Problem 5
statement: Mr. Patrick teaches math to \(15\) students. He was grading tests and found that when he graded everyone’s test except Payton’s, the average grade for the class was \(80.\) After he graded Payton’s test, the class average became \(81.\) What was Payton’s score on the test?

solutions.text:
The total for the first \(14\) graded tests was \(14\cdot 80=1120\).

After Payton’s test was included, the total became \(15\cdot 81=1215\). Therefore Payton’s score was \(1215-1120=95\).

Thus, E is the correct answer.
hints: Total score equals the average times the number of graded tests
Subtract the first \(14\) students’ total from the full class total
